derivation: from H1323 (בַּת) and H7771 (שׁוֹעַ); daughter of wealth;  the same as H1339 (בַּת־שֶׁבַע)

occurrences.text: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the Lord; and he slew him.
And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath–shua the daughter of Ammiel:
